$description: Accessibility requirements by route/component, targeting WCAG 2.2 AA.

global.headingHierarchy: single h1 per page, sequential h2/h3, verified on all 28 routes
global.landmarks: header/nav, main, footer on every page
global.contrast: 4.5:1 body text, 3:1 large/headline text, verified against each page-theme background
global.reducedMotion: every custom animation has a reduced-motion equivalent, see axieonex-motion.json
global.colorOnly: no state communicated by color alone (form errors always paired with text, toggles always paired with a label)

routes.keyboard: nav, magnetic CTAs, FAQ all keyboard operable
routes.focus: hero text never depends on animation for visibility

routes.keyboard: scroll-chapter content must remain in DOM order for keyboard/reader users, not purely scroll-jacked
diagram nodes are real buttons, tabbable in a logical order
routes.focus: selecting a node moves visible focus/aria-live update to the panel
routes.labels: node buttons have accessible names (service names)
routes.liveRegions: aria-live polite on panel content swap

routes.headingStructure: h1 service name, h2 per subsection
h1, h2 featured, h2 per article card
routes.liveRegions: aria-live announcing result count on filter/search

routes.headingStructure: h1 title, sequential h2/h3 for body sections

routes.keyboard: full form tabbable in logical order
routes.focus: first invalid field receives focus on failed submit
routes.labels: every field has a programmatic label

routes.focus: focus moves to new step's heading on step change
routes.labels: every field labeled, error text linked via aria-describedby
routes.liveRegions: aria-live for step change, validation errors, submission result

routes.keyboard: TOC links keyboard operable, anchor targets have scroll-margin-top
every switch is a native checkbox, operable via space/enter
routes.labels: every switch has a visible label plus description

routes.keyboard: recovery links immediately focusable, not gated by animation
routes.focus: h1 or main receives focus on load
